clue.text: Loud child, suppressing every other character, it's clear

indicators.note: keeping down every second letter of the two words leaves only the alternate letters standing

explanation.surface: A noisy child is told to keep quiet on alternate turns, which makes things plain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suppressing every other character' looks like a description of the child's behaviour, but it tells you to drop every second letter of LOUDCHILD, leaving the first, third, fifth, seventh and ninth.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucid writing or thinking is transparent and easy to understand, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Got rid of agent in hopeless enterprise

parts.note: to have lost something is to have got rid of it
a cause is the agent that brings something about

explanation.surface: A spy was dismissed during a doomed mission.
explanation.definitionFit: A lost cause is a venture with no chance of success.

clue.text: In this part of church, say, to seek enlightenment

definitions.text: In this part of church, say, to seek enlightenment

parts.words: In this part of church, say, to seek enlightenment
parts.note: put 'in' before the name of the singers' area of a church and say it: it sounds like a verb meaning to ask

explanation.surface: Someone goes to a section of the church to look for spiritual insight.
explanation.walkthrough: The area where the singers sit, with 'in' before it, is spoken like 'enquire', which means to seek information.
explanation.definitionFit: The choir is the part of a church between nave and altar where the singers sit.

clue.text: Myth one bard exploded in passionate verse

indicators.note: blown apart, so the letters fly and land in a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A poet's legend bursts into heated poetry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exploded' rearranges MYTH, I and BARD.
explanation.definitionFit: A dithyramb is a wild, impassioned choral hymn or poem, originally to Dionysus.

clue.text: Detected in error, so dismissed

definitions.meaning: someone found out in a mistake or lie has been exposed
in cricket a batsman whose hit is held by a fielder before it lands is out by that method

explanation.surface: A player's mistake is spotted and they are sent off.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a batsman is dismissed this way when a fielder catches the ball straight off the bat.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means exposed in a mistake, and is also a standard cricket mode of dismissal.

clue.text: An obstacle to sharp practice

definitions.meaning: a tight bend inserted in a racetrack to slow cars
trickery, as in the related word chicanery

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a barrier of tight turns on a race circuit and an old word for trickery.

clue.text: Clumsily intrude, not yet experienced

indicators.note: done clumsily, the letters fall into a different order

explanation.surface: An inexperienced person barges in awkwardly.
explanation.definitionFit: Untried means not tested or proven by experience.

clue.text: Successful attempt to preserve a bachelor's routine

indicators.note: the success keeps the other letters safe inside it

parts.note: a hit is a shot that succeeds
B is the abbreviation for bachelor, as in a BA degree

explanation.surface: A single man's daily routine survives a lucky try.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to preserve' holds A and B inside HIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit is a settled practice done regularly, a fixed custom.

clue.text: Extra device that's made after the contract is completed

definitions.text: made after the contract is completed

parts.note: over means extra, as in left over
a trick is a device or ruse

explanation.surface: A clever add-on clause slipped in after a deal is signed.
explanation.walkthrough: In the card game bridge, the 'contract' is the bid; tricks won beyond it are extra ones.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge an overtrick is any trick won beyond the number the declarer bid for.

clue.text: Short pronouncement in the office

indicators.note: the word for short is said, and a different spelling comes out

parts.note: terse means short and curt in speech

explanation.surface: A curt announcement made at work.
explanation.walkthrough: In church use an 'office' is a service of daily prayer; terce is the one at the third hour.
explanation.definitionFit: Terce is one of the canonical hours of daily prayer, held mid-morning.

clue.text: The chosen few abruptly enter

parts.note: to stop short is to stop abruptly
to list something is to enter it in a register

explanation.surface: An elite group makes a sudden entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortlist is the small group of candidates selected for final consideration.

clue.text: Obscure section of formidable army

indicators.note: section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a fearsome military force is kept out of sight.
explanation.definitionFit: To blear is to dim or blur, as tears blur the eyes, so it means to make indistinct.

clue.text: Win support

definitions.meaning: to ... a vote or the day is to win it
to ... a load is to bear or hold it up

explanation.definitionFit: Carry means both to gain a victory, as in carrying the motion, and to bear a weight.

clue.text: Child in Israel developed into. philosopher

indicators.note: the child goes inside the reworked letters of the country
developed suggests the letters of the country grow into a new form

parts.note: a tot is a small child

explanation.surface: A child in Israel grows up to become a great thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developed' is the anagram signal, reworking the country into ARISLE; 'in' then places the small child within those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Aristotle was the ancient Greek thinker who studied under Plato, an example of the class.

clue.text: Mounted coach further from the house'

parts.note: mounted means up, as a rider is up on a horse
a stage is a stagecoach, an old horse-drawn coach

explanation.surface: A horseman on a coach drives away from the house.
explanation.walkthrough: In the theatre the 'house' is the audience; the back of the stage, furthest from them, is up-stage.
explanation.definitionFit: In theatre terms this means towards the back of the stage, away from the audience seated in the auditorium.

clue.text: Symbolic plan to revise catechism

indicators.note: revising the religious text alters the order of its letters

explanation.surface: A diagram intended to update religious teaching.
explanation.definitionFit: A schematic is a diagram showing parts in simplified symbols.

clue.text: Moving picture

definitions.meaning: ... a cart along is pulling or moving it
a sketch made with pencil or pen

explanation.surface: A film, or motion picture.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a film, but the two words are separate senses: pulling along, and a sketch.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means pulling something along and also a sketched image.

clue.text: A party intended, say, to create confusion

parts.note: a bash is a lively party

indicators.note: say signals the word for intended is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: meant means intended

explanation.surface: A party deliberately organised to cause chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' gives MENT, which sounds like 'meant'.
explanation.definitionFit: Abashment is embarrassed disconcertion, a state of being flustered.

clue.text: Assemble groups to run power equipment

parts.note: genera are classes or groups in biology
R is the cricket abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: Gather groups to operate the electricity machinery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Assemble' just tells you to put the pieces together.
explanation.definitionFit: A generator is a machine that produces electrical power.

clue.text: Success, once, with book I included in display

parts.note: ex means former or once, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: the book and the I go inside the word for success

parts.note: a hit is a success, like a hit record

explanation.surface: A former triumph, together with a book and a personal touch, is put on show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'once' is the usual crossword signal for 'former'; 'included' signals the book and the letter going inside the word for success.
explanation.definitionFit: An exhibit is something put on public show in a museum or gallery.

clue.text: Gut feeling lacking in education

indicators.note: the word for gut feeling goes without the two letters named next

parts.note: intuition is a gut feeling or instinct

explanation.surface: Instinct is absent from schooling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' removes IN from the start of INTUITION.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuition is teaching or instruction.

clue.text: Judge has' knowledge required to listen to the old

parts.note: a judge hears a case in court
ken is range of knowledge, as in beyond one's ken

explanation.surface: A judge with experience must pay attention to elderly people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to the old' is part of the definition: listen, in an archaic word. It looks like 'listen to old people'.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an old-fashioned or poetic verb meaning to pay attention to what is said.

clue.text: Fury after' agreement between husband and wife gets out of control

indicators.note: the anger comes after the married pair
agreement sits between the husband and the wife

parts.note: ay is an old spelling of aye, yes
ire is anger or fury

explanation.surface: Marital harmony is wrecked when rage follows a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Haywire means erratic and chaotic, as in a machine going haywire.

clue.text: It's useful to get civility out of a Government department

indicators.note: the courtesy word stands outside the department's initials

parts.note: comity is courtesy and considerate behaviour
MOD is the Ministry of Defence

explanation.surface: Someone hopes to find politeness from a Whitehall ministry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of' is read as 'outside' here; the Ministry of Defence is the British government department in charge of the armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: In older usage a commodity is a convenience or something of use, before the trading sense of goods.

clue.text: Press reveals disagreement among diplomats

indicators.note: the quarrel goes among the diplomats' initials

parts.note: CD is the corps diplomatique, the diplomatic body
a row is a quarrel

explanation.surface: Journalists expose a quarrel among ambassadors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Press' looks like journalists, but as a noun it means a throng.
explanation.definitionFit: A press of people is a dense throng.

clue.text: Divine inhabitant of Peak District

parts.note: a minor goddess of Greek myth living on a mountain, with a peak area pictured as her home

explanation.surface: A clergyman living in the English national park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Divine' suggests a clergyman and the Peak District is an English national park; read literally, it is a goddess who lives on peaks.
explanation.definitionFit: An oread is a mountain nymph in Greek mythology.

clue.text: The wayfarer's power, at last on the increase

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece on another follows it

parts.note: a hike is a rise, as in a price hike

indicators.note: the final letter of power is taken

explanation.surface: A traveller's strength grows in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at last' takes R from power, and 'on' puts it after HIKE.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiker is a walker on long journeys on foot, a kind of traveller.

clue.text: Scoundrel's honour

definitions.meaning: in card games the jack is one of the honours, the top cards

explanation.definitionFit: A knave is a rogue, and in cards it is the jack, one of the honour cards.

clue.text: Open about being extravagant

parts.note: out means open, as a flower is out
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Being frank about one's lavish lifestyle.
explanation.definitionFit: Outré means unconventional and bizarre, beyond the usual bounds.

clue.text: Books on information technology in the age of the traveller

indicators.note: in an across clue the books come after the rest

parts.note: an era is an age or period
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Bible texts about computing in the modern era, aimed at someone on the move.
explanation.definitionFit: An itinerant is someone who travels from place to place, such as a wandering preacher.

clue.text: New church required after some years of deterioration

indicators.note: the new church comes after the span of years

parts.note: a decade is a span of ten years
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A fresh church is needed after years of decline.
explanation.definitionFit: Decadence is moral or cultural decline, a state of decay.

clue.text: The unfairness at the heart of other people

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its middle letters

explanation.surface: Injustice is central to how others behave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at the heart' takes IR, the middle two letters of unfairness.
explanation.definitionFit: The possessive pronoun means belonging to them, others already mentioned.
